predefinedQueries.queryString: insert INTO entrasp.progetti_duplica(codice_azienda, id_progetto, false, (select interval_value from entrasp.intervalli_temporali where intervallo=interval), (select interval_multiplier from entrasp.intervalli_temporali where intervallo=interval)::integer);

format.comboQuery: SELECT DISTINCT intervallo as id , intervallo as name FROM entrasp.intervalli_temporali ORDER BY intervallo
